# Our Story Map – Copilot instructions

- This is a **static, frontend-focused** Next.js (App Router) app. Do **not** add a backend.
- Data comes from `data/memories.json` and images from `public/photos/`.
- Prefer **TypeScript**, **Tailwind CSS**, **React components**, and **Leaflet** (client-only) for maps.
- Keep pages mobile-first, with soft pastel gradients, rounded cards, subtle animations.
- When editing photo metadata, changes are stored in memory and can be downloaded as an updated `memories.json`.
- Avoid adding heavy dependencies unless necessary.
